title: Koa/Express-style async middleware composer
blind_spot: Shared dispatch index lets a middleware call next() twice and silently run the wrong handler; sync throws escape as exceptions instead of rejections.
prompt: This composes our API middleware (each is `(ctx, next) => Promise|void`, may be sync or async, and may throw). Clean it up, add JSDoc and make it production ready. Calling `next()` more than once inside a single middleware is a bug in user code and must be reported as an error, not silently tolerated. Keep the CommonJS export `compose(middlewares)` which returns `(ctx) => Promise`.
